title: Atoms to Processes: The Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Chemical Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2610.02014v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid maturation of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) has catalyzed a profound shift in how chemical engineering problems are formulated, analyzed, and solved. Advances in computing, data availability, and learning algorithms have enabled AI/ML methods to impact applications spanning atomic-scale simulations, materials and catalyst discovery, transport and thermodynamics, separations, process systems engineering, and industrial operations. This article provides a perspective on recent methodological developments and representative applications, emphasizing how AI/ML tools are being integrated with first-principles models to address challenges of predictive accuracy, data scarcity, extrapolation, interpretability, and model lifecycle management. Across domains, a unifying trend is the move away from purely black-box approaches toward hybrid and physics-informed frameworks that explicitly respect conservation laws,

translated_title: 从原子到过程：人工智能与机器学习在化学工程中的作用
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）与机器学习（ML）的快速成熟，催化了化学工程问题构建、分析和解决方式的深刻转变。计算能力、数据可得性和学习算法的进步，使AI/ML方法得以影响从原子尺度模拟、材料与催化剂发现、传递与热力学、分离过程、过程系统工程到工业运营等广泛的应用领域。本文对近年来的方法学发展和代表性应用进行了评述，重点强调AI/ML工具如何与第一性原理模型相融合，以应对预测精度、数据稀缺、外推能力、可解释性和模型生命周期管理等挑战。纵观各个领域，一个统一的趋势是：研究正从纯黑箱方法转向明确遵循守恒定律的混合式与物理信息驱动的框架。
tldr: 本文综述了人工智能与机器学习在化学工程各领域（从原子尺度模拟到工业运营）的最新方法进展与代表性应用，并指出该领域的统一趋势是从纯黑箱方法转向与第一性原理结合、遵循守恒定律的物理信息混合框架。
en_tdlr: This article reviews recent AI/ML methodological advances and representative applications across chemical engineering—from atomic-scale simulations to industrial operations—highlighting the field-wide shift from purely black-box approaches toward hybrid, physics-informed frameworks that explicitly respect conservation laws.
